children.value: > Fact From Story Bankman-Fried said that he found out about the fiat@ftx account in June 2022 but did not discover what the account was for until October.
> > Fact From Story His employees told him “they were busy and I should stop asking questions because it was distracting.”
> > > Fact From Story Bankman-Fried found out about the fiat@ftx account in June 2022.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge June is before October.
> > Commonsense Knowledge If someone does not know what an account is for, they would ask what it is for.
> Fact From Story Bankman-Fried directed alleged co-conspirator Caroline Ellison to repay third-party loans and went on making investments.
> > Fact From Story Sam Bankman-Fried didn’t ask where the $8 billion went
> > > Fact From Story Bankman-Fried couldn’t recall knowing anything about who was making decisions to spend $8 billion of customer funds.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A CEO or CFO would ask where the money went if billions of dollars were missing from their company.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Usually, if someone finds out about an $8 billion accounting error, they would ask where the money went.
